reads.name: healthy_hot
sql: SELECT * FROM profile
PRAGMA user_version
SELECT name,sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE sql IS NOT NULL ORDER BY name LIMIT ?
PRAGMA data_version
SELECT * FROM accepted
SELECT * FROM generations WHERE id=?
SELECT 1 FROM generation_roots WHERE generation_id=? AND hash=?
SELECT receipt FROM generations WHERE id=?
SELECT id FROM generations WHERE id IS NOT ? AND id IS NOT ?
BEGIN DEFERRED
SELECT length(body) AS n FROM objects WHERE hash=?
SELECT o.*,r.bytes AS size FROM objects o JOIN refs r USING(hash) WHERE hash=?
SELECT e.*,r.bytes FROM edges e JOIN refs r ON r.hash=e.child WHERE parent=? ORDER BY position
ROLLBACK

reads.name: fresh_recovery_hot
sql: SELECT * FROM profile
PRAGMA user_version
SELECT name,sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE sql IS NOT NULL ORDER BY name LIMIT ?
PRAGMA data_version
SELECT * FROM accepted
SELECT * FROM generations WHERE id=?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM generation_roots WHERE generation_id=?
SELECT 1 FROM generation_roots WHERE generation_id=? AND hash=?
SELECT receipt FROM generations WHERE id=?
SELECT length(body) AS n FROM objects WHERE hash=?
SELECT o.*,r.bytes AS size FROM objects o JOIN refs r USING(hash) WHERE hash=?
SELECT e.*,r.bytes FROM edges e JOIN refs r ON r.hash=e.child WHERE parent=? ORDER BY position

WITH RECURSIVE closure(hash) AS (SELECT hash FROM generation_roots WHERE generation_id=? UNION SELECT e.child FROM edges e JOIN closure c ON e.parent=c.hash) SELECT r.hash,r.bytes FROM closure JOIN refs r USING(hash) ORDER BY r.hash
SELECT id FROM generations WHERE id IS NOT ? AND id IS NOT ?
BEGIN DEFERRED
ROLLBACK
